# ledger_manual_payment (Data Source)

Reads one manual payment record of an occurrence: a payment recorded by hand, which is user data and not a bank fact. Amounts are exact decimal strings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ledger_manual_payment" "march_rent" {
  occurrence_id = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA"
  id            = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNB"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The identifier of the payment record (a ULID).
- `occurrence_id` (String) The occurrence the payment is for.

### Read-Only

- `amount` (String) The amount paid, an exact decimal string with its original scale.
- `created_at` (String) When it was recorded (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `currency` (String) The ISO 4217 currency code of amount.
- `note` (String) The free-text note, or null.
- `paid_on` (String) The day the payment was made, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `replaced_by_match_id` (String) The confirmed bank payment match that now stands in for this record (it is then kept but does not count), or null.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version of the record.
